The Honorable the Secretary of the Interior June 30, 1972

include such surveys along with agricultural, forestry, and construction operations would appear unjustified on any reasonable basis.
Our nearly 8000 members would be adversely and vitally affected in their activities on the public lands of the United States by being required to adhere to regulations designed for recreational activities. On behalf of our membership, I strongly urge that you amend your instructions to the Assistant Secretaries to except geological and geophysical survey equipment, while being used exclusively for their designed purposes, from the general category of off-road vehicle to which the proposed regulations will apply.
Sincerely,
Carl H. Savit
President
